statement: The dataset is pure synthetic noise: all predictor columns are statistically independent of performance_rating and of each other.
rationale: performance_rating has mean ~50 and std ~10 consistent with a random normal draw; the framing explicitly warns the dataset may be entirely synthetic with independent columns.
null_hypothesis: All pairwise correlations between predictors and performance_rating are zero in the population.
test_strategy: Compute Pearson and Spearman correlations with Bonferroni-corrected p-values; run a permutation test on the OLS R-squared.
verdict_rule: SUPPORTED if no correlation survives Bonferroni correction AND observed R-squared is below the 95th percentile of the permuted null distribution.

statement: At least one numeric predictor has a non-trivial linear or monotonic correlation (|r| > 0.1) with performance_rating.
rationale: Even small but genuine correlations would indicate predictive signal and justify further modelling.
null_hypothesis: All pairwise Pearson and Spearman correlations with performance_rating are zero.
test_strategy: Correlation matrix with p-values; apply Bonferroni correction for 7 simultaneous tests against performance_rating.
verdict_rule: SUPPORTED if at least one correlation has |r| > 0.1 AND corrected p < 0.05.

statement: A multivariate OLS regression using all predictors explains statistically significant variance in performance_rating beyond what a null model would achieve.
rationale: With 800 rows and 8 predictors, even noise can produce a nominally significant F-test; a permutation test guards against this.
null_hypothesis: The population R-squared of the full model is zero.
test_strategy: Fit OLS, record R-squared and F-statistic; compare R-squared against a 1000-permutation null distribution.
verdict_rule: SUPPORTED if observed R-squared exceeds the 95th percentile of the permuted null AND F-test p < 0.05.

statement: commute_minutes is right-skewed with outliers that could violate regression assumptions.
rationale: Column summary shows mean 24.5 but max 120, with 75th percentile at 33 — suggesting a long right tail.
null_hypothesis: commute_minutes is symmetric with no extreme outliers (IQR rule).
test_strategy: Compute skewness statistic; identify outliers via 1.5*IQR rule; visualise with boxplot.
verdict_rule: SUPPORTED if skewness > 1.0 OR more than 5% of values lie beyond the IQR fences.

statement: salary_band levels have distinct profiles across numeric features, making salary_band a meaningful grouping variable.
rationale: If salary_band is independent of all numeric features, it is likely randomly assigned (noise). Distinct profiles would suggest real structure.
null_hypothesis: The distribution of each numeric feature is identical across all salary_band levels.
test_strategy: Kruskal-Wallis test for each numeric feature grouped by salary_band; report H-statistic and p-value.
verdict_rule: SUPPORTED if at least one feature shows a Bonferroni-corrected p < 0.05 across salary_band groups.

statement: Numeric predictors exhibit meaningful multicollinearity (VIF > 5 for at least one predictor).
rationale: Multicollinearity inflates standard errors and makes individual coefficient estimates unreliable. Needs checking before interpreting OLS coefficients.
test_strategy: Compute VIF for each numeric predictor in the OLS design matrix.
verdict_rule: SUPPORTED if any predictor has VIF > 5.

statement: The feature space has latent structure — PCA reveals that fewer components than the number of features explain a disproportionate share of total variance.
rationale: If features are truly independent, each principal component should explain roughly equal variance (~1/p). Concentrated variance indicates latent structure.
null_hypothesis: Principal component explained-variance ratios are approximately uniform (each ~1/7 for 7 numeric features).
test_strategy: PCA on standardised numeric features; scree plot; check whether the first 2-3 components explain >60% of total variance.
verdict_rule: SUPPORTED if the first 2 components explain >40% of total variance (vs ~28.6% expected under independence).
